find_places.description: Find the towns, cities and villages for a postal code, or the postal codes of a place, in Germany, Austria, Switzerland or Liechtenstein. Each place comes with its municipality, district and state. Give a postal code, a name or both.
find_places.display_name: Find places by postal code or name
find_places.display_str_template: Find places by postal code or name in OpenPLZ API.

mock_response.summary: Found 1 place in Germany for postal code '10117' (exact).

find_places.name: find_places

parameters.description: The country to look in. Defaults to Germany.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: A postal code, or its first digits to find every code that starts with them. D-10117 and 10 117 work too.
parameters.name: postal_code

parameters.description: The town, city or village, such as München.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: How names and postal codes are compared with what you type, ignoring upper and lower case. Defaults to Starts with. Pattern reads your text as a regular expression.
parameters.name: match

parameters.description: Which page of results to get, from 1. Defaults to the first.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many results a page holds, 1 to 50. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Get every result at once, up to 1,000, instead of one page. Page and Page size are then ignored.
parameters.name: all_pages

count.description: How many are in this result.

has_more.description: True when more match than this result holds.

next_page.description: The page to ask for next with the same page size; empty on the last page.

district.description: The district (Kreis or Bezirk) it is in. Empty in Liechtenstein and in Berlin and Hamburg, which have none.

district_key.description: The district's key, for the District field of 'List municipalities' or 'List places in an area'.

label.description: The postal code and place together, ready for an address line, e.g. '10117 Berlin'.

municipality.description: The municipality (Gemeinde or commune) it belongs to, e.g. 'Berlin, Stadt'.

municipality_key.description: The municipality's official key: the 8-digit regional key in Germany, the Gemeindekennziffer in Austria, the commune number in Switzerland and Liechtenstein.

municipality_type.description: What kind of municipality it is, e.g. 'Kreisfreie Stadt' or 'Marktgemeinde'. Germany and Austria only.

name.description: The place: a town, city or village, e.g. 'Berlin'.

state.description: The federal state, province or canton it is in. Empty in Liechtenstein.

state_key.description: The key of the federal state, province or canton, e.g. '09' for Bayern.

state_short_name.description: The canton's two-letter abbreviation, e.g. 'ZH'. Switzerland only.

summary.description: One line saying what was found, e.g. 'Found 1 place in Germany'.

total.description: How many match in all, across every page.

total_pages.description: How many pages there are at this page size.

find_streets.description: Find streets by name, postal code or place, or any mix, to check an address or find a street's postal code. Each street comes with its place, borough (Germany), municipality, district and state.

description: Look up postal codes, places and streets in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Liechtenstein: find the town for a postal code or the postal codes of a town, check that a street exists, search addresses, and list states, districts and municipalities with their official keys. Open data, no account or API key needed.
